title: CWP/3659/2021 of KULBHUSHAN JAIN Vs UNION OF INDIA AND OTHERS
text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF PUNJAB AND HARYANA AT CHANDIGARH (205) CWP-3659-2021 Date of Decision : 16.09.2025 Kulbhushan Jain …Petitioner Versus Union of India and others ...Respondents CORAM: HON’BLE MR. JUSTICE KULDEEP TIWARI Present: Dr. Deepak Jindal, Advocate for the petitioner. Mr. Sandeep Bhatia, Sr. Standing Counsel for respondents No.1 to 3-Union of India. Mr. Abhinav Sood, Advocate and Mr. Sayyam Garg, Advocate for respondents No.4 and 5. KULDEEP TIWARI, J.(ORAL)

1. Through the instant writ petition, challenge is thrown to the communications dated 07.11.2019 and 28.11.2019 (Annexures P-5 and P-7), made by the Deputy Registrar, Central Information Commission, New Delhi, wherethrough, certain objections were raised on second appeal/complaint preferred by the petitioner.

2. Perusal of the objections, as raised by the Registry of Central Information Commission, New Delhi, reflects that the petitioner was required to submit the second appeal/complaint with justification and declaration to the extent that HDFC Bank Limited, is a public authority, along with supporting documents as per Section 2 (h) of the Right to Information Act, 2005 MANPREET SINGH authenticity of this order/judgment

3. The petitioner, instead of making compliance to the objections (supra), raised by the Registry of Central Information Commission, New Delhi, has filed the instant writ petition, challenging the communications (supra).

4. This Court is of the considered opinion that instant writ petition, is in fact, a misconceived motion. The petitioner, ought to have made compliance, as desired by the Registry of Central Information Commission, New Delhi.

5. Consequently, the instant writ petition is disposed of.

6. In case, the petitioner files such an application, and makes compliance to the objections (supra), the Registrar, Central Information Commission, New Delhi, shall take apt decision, in accordance with law.

7. Ordered accordingly. (KULDEEP TIWARI) JUDGE September 16, 2025 Manpreet authenticity of this order/judgment
